_description: Performance baseline for issue #391 PERFORMANCE slice (4 boxes: cascade BFS / HybridRetriever / BM25 rebuild / Postgres slow log). Four of the six baselines (cascade_5hop_bfs + bm25_build_1k/5k/10k) are CI-blessed from 3 workflow_dispatch runs on the feat/403-perf-baseline-rebless branch (see _blessed_from_ci_runs); the harness compares current p50/p95 wall-clock against these baselines and fails on regression beyond the documented tolerance band. The two HybridRetriever baselines (p50/p95) remain at 0.0 because the live retriever skips in CI without SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_KEY + OPENAI_API_KEY — re-bless tracked in GH #414. Real production targets are listed in _target_* fields for reference; baseline mean_ms values reflect the CI runner shape, not the absolute targets. When re-blessing a baseline, replicate the 3-run methodology (workflow_dispatch on the rebless branch) and update _blessed_from_ci_runs to match.
_methodology: Each of the 3 CI workflow_dispatch runs above ran scripts/run_benchmarks.sh against the in-memory _FakeSupabaseGraph (cascade) + reference BM25 builder (bm25). Per-run median_ms is captured in test-results/measurements-*.json artifacts on each run; the baseline mean_ms below is the median-of-medians across the 3 runs (median across runs = primary statistic; stdev across runs reported in _observed_variance_pct). Tolerance band derivation (codex iter-2 closure of M1): relative band = 10% safety floor (~5-7x observed stdev), absolute band = ~2x observed full-timing range rounded up to nearest 5ms (min 5ms floor); the comparison helper uses max(rel_band, abs_band) so each box's effective band is also tracked explicitly in _effective_band_pct for review-time honesty.

cascade_5hop_bfs._target_rationale: Issue #391 PERFORMANCE box 1: '< 500ms for 5-hop BFS'. Synthetic graph shape may not match production graph; tolerance band is relative to blessed baseline, not the absolute target.
cascade_5hop_bfs._ci_observation: 3 CI runs (workflow_dispatch on feat/403-perf-baseline-rebless) produced per-run median_ms [352.54, 357.23, 363.27]; med-of-meds=357.23ms, stdev across runs=5.38ms (1.51%), range across 15 individual timings=20.09ms (345.95–366.04). p95 across runs was tight (med-of-p95s=365.41ms). The synthetic in-memory _FakeSupabaseGraph traverses ~1000 reachable nodes per cascade so absolute numbers reflect Python-side BFS overhead on the ubuntu-latest CI runner, NOT real Supabase round-trips. The 500ms absolute target remains the documentation anchor for an eventual real-Postgres measurement.
cascade_5hop_bfs._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 45ms absolute (whichever wider). Comparison helper takes max(rel, abs) so effective band is 45ms = 12.6% of baseline (rel band 35.72ms is dominated by abs floor; 8.3x observed stdev/med = 1.51%). Absolute band 45ms = ~2x observed full-timing range (20.09ms across 15 samples in 3 runs), rounded up to nearest 5ms. Narrowed from the pre-#403 100ms placeholder (28% effective) per codex iter-2 M1 (honest derivation: abs floor should be close to observed range, not 5x it).

hybrid_retriever_search_p50._target_rationale: Issue #391 PERFORMANCE box 2: '< 200ms for fused search'. Live retriever in CI skips when SUPABASE_URL/OPENAI_API_KEY absent; baseline is blessed on the first environment that has both.
hybrid_retriever_search_p50._placeholder_rationale: Remains at 0.0 (placeholder) until a CI run has SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_KEY + OPENAI_API_KEY available — the test currently skips with `requires_supabase` + `sk-*` shape check. The pre-#403 36-query dev-box run (no sk-* OPENAI key — dense stream degraded gracefully to []) produced p50~336ms which was NOT representative; we deliberately do NOT re-bless from a degraded-stream measurement. Re-bless tracked in GH #414 — when secrets land, follow the same 3-run methodology used for the cascade + bm25 baselines (see _methodology above).
hybrid_retriever_search_p50._tolerance_rationale: 20% relative OR 50ms absolute. Wider band than cascade because network round-trips dominate; absolute band protects against jitter. Bands carried forward from PR #401 pending CI re-bless (GH #414).

hybrid_retriever_search_p95._target_rationale: Tail-latency budget: p95 should not exceed 2.5x the p50 target (200ms). 500ms is a conservative tail-latency ceiling for a 3-stream fused search.
hybrid_retriever_search_p95._placeholder_rationale: Remains at 0.0 (placeholder) for the same reason as hybrid_retriever_search_p50 — see that entry's _placeholder_rationale. The pre-#403 36-query dev-box run produced p95~1041ms (with degraded dense stream); NOT representative; we deliberately do NOT re-bless from that data. Re-bless tracked in GH #414.
hybrid_retriever_search_p95._tolerance_rationale: 25% relative OR 100ms absolute. p95 is noisier than p50 — wider tolerance is appropriate. Bands carried forward from PR #401 pending CI re-bless (GH #414).

bm25_build_1k._ci_observation: 3 CI runs produced per-run median_ms [20.55, 21.08, 21.07]; med-of-meds=21.07ms, stdev across runs=0.30ms (1.42%), range across 9 individual timings=2.01ms (20.44–22.45). Build time for 1000-doc corpus via the reference Python BM25 implementation; corpus repeats from synthetic_corpus.jsonl to fill the slice.
bm25_build_1k._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 5ms absolute (whichever wider). Comparison helper takes max(rel, abs) so effective band is 5ms = 23.7% of baseline. The small-baseline absolute-floor consequence is unavoidable: at a 21ms baseline, 10% relative is just 2.11ms which equals only ~1x observed range — too tight to clear routine CI jitter. 5ms absolute floor = ~2.5x observed range (2.01ms) = ~16.7x observed stdev/med (1.42%); narrowed from the pre-#403 50ms placeholder (237% effective — was effectively unbounded). If the 23.7% effective band proves too loose in practice, the principled tightening is to add more replicate runs and re-derive stdev from a larger sample, not to lower the abs floor below the observed range.

bm25_build_5k._ci_observation: 3 CI runs produced per-run median_ms [107.94, 111.19, 111.10]; med-of-meds=111.10ms, stdev across runs=1.85ms (1.66%), range across 9 individual timings=6.33ms (106.80–113.14).
bm25_build_5k._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 15ms absolute (whichever wider). Comparison helper takes max(rel, abs) so effective band is 15ms = 13.5% of baseline (rel band 11.11ms is just under the abs floor). Absolute band 15ms = ~2.4x observed full-timing range (6.33ms across 9 samples in 3 runs); narrowed from the pre-#403 100ms placeholder (90% effective) per codex iter-2 M1.

bm25_build_10k._ci_observation: 3 CI runs produced per-run median_ms [224.85, 222.14, 216.50]; med-of-meds=222.14ms, stdev across runs=4.26ms (1.92%), range across 9 individual timings=12.21ms (215.35–227.56).
bm25_build_10k._tolerance_rationale: 10% relative OR 25ms absolute (whichever wider). Comparison helper takes max(rel, abs) so effective band is 25ms = 11.3% of baseline (rel band 22.21ms is just under the abs floor). Absolute band 25ms = ~2x observed full-timing range (12.21ms); narrowed from the pre-#403 200ms placeholder (90% effective) per codex iter-2 M1.
